statement:
∀ (f : ℂ → ℂ) (c : ℂ) (r R : ℝ),
  0 < r →
    r ≤ R →
      ContinuousOn f (closedBall c R \ ball c r) →
        (∀ z ∈ ball c R \ closedBall c r, DifferentiableAt ℂ f z) →
          ∀ (n : ℤ), ∮ (z : ℂ) in C(c, R), f z * (z - c) ^ (-n - 1) = ∮ (z : ℂ) in C(c, r), f z * (z - c) ^ (-n - 1)

universal.type: ContinuousOn f (closedBall c R \ ball c r)
universal.name: hc

universal.type: ∀ z ∈ ball c R \ closedBall c r, DifferentiableAt ℂ f z
universal.name: hd

hyps.text: ContinuousOn f (closedBall c R \ ball c r)
hyps.name: hc

hyps.text: ∀ z ∈ ball c R \ closedBall c r, DifferentiableAt ℂ f z
hyps.name: hd

goal.rhs: ∮ (z : ℂ) in C(c, r), f z * (z - c) ^ (-n - 1)
goal.lhs: ∮ (z : ℂ) in C(c, R), f z * (z - c) ^ (-n - 1)

atoms: ∮ (z : ℂ) in C(c, R), f z * (z - c) ^ (-n - 1)
∮ (z : ℂ) in C(c, r), f z * (z - c) ^ (-n - 1)
